old_definition: Perfect order was on-time and in-full only
new_definition: Perfect order rate now includes damage-free and correct documentation

old_definition: On-time meant delivered within 1 day of the PO due date; in-full meant within 2% of the ordered quantity
new_definition: On-time means delivered on the scheduled date or earlier within the booked delivery slot (no grace day); in-full means 100% of the ordered quantity
change_reason: Tightened to match the customer promise; applied from the start of September so September OTIF is not comparable with earlier months
